"Hi Kajal, welcome!  It's great to finally meet you.  I've reviewed your resume and I'm particularly impressed with your projects, especially the Java-based inventory management system and the web-based expense tracker.  Your skills in Java, Python, and front-end technologies like React and Tailwind are also very relevant to the roles we have available.

To start, could you please tell me a bit about yourself?  I'd love to hear about your background, your interests within the tech field, and what you're hoping to achieve in your next role."

Thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today. I've truly enjoyed learning more about your experience and skills, and I've gained some valuable insights into how you could contribute to our team.  The next step is for the team to review all applications, and we will be in touch within [ timeframe, e.g.,  a week ] to let you know the outcome.  Thank you again, and we wish you all the best.
